records.subject: Nipah- virology institute for kerala
records.SM_Text:
Shri Haris Beeran: I? wish to drawyour attention to Nipah virus outbreaks in Kerala which has been declared as health emergency. The deadly virus resulted in the death of a 14 year old boy last Sunday. Nipah virus outbreaks have haunted Kerala on four-occasionsin past. Outbreak of the virus were reported in 2018 and 2023 in Kozhikode and 2019 in Ernakulam. The Department of Health in Kerala has taken precautionary measures and multiple level surveillance mechanismis in place. But the biggest impediment faced in such diseases outbreak, which was seen also during Nipah virus outbreak in is the inadequacy of virus testing facilities in the country. Currently for viral testing, the only centre in India is the National Institute of virology- Pune. It is a matter of grave concern that there is only one advanced centre for virology testing catering to 140 million population of the country. It is highly inadequate in a country like India to have only one viral testing center and this delays the detection and containment of deadly infection disease like NIPAH and other similar disease. NIV Pune, the result comes after a week time, which is causing delay in roll-out of strategy of containment of such deadly infection diseases.? I therefore request the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to take immediate steps to provide funding support to develop viral testing facilities in national institute virology in Alappuzha and institute of advance virology in Trivandrum and make them center of excellence to tackle such diseases outbreaks.

(Ends)

records.subject: Exponential increase in air fares being charged by the air line companies
records.SM_Text:
Shri Haris Beeran: I am raising the matter regarding the exponential increase in air fares being charged by the air line companies with particular reference to the gulf region. Rule 134 of the aircraft rules, states that there cannot be any monopoly or cartalization with regard to the air fares. The DGCA is the appropriate authority in this regard. The majority of expats in the Gulf area are engaged in blue-collar jobs. They face excessive airfares, particularly on AI-Express.? It is also pertinent to note that there are numerous complaints against AI Express regarding irregular price hikes, inconsistent flight schedules, and abrupt cancellations. On 9th? May 2024 , 85 AI-Express flights (out of 380) were cancelled across the country. And on? 12th?? May, 52 flights were cancelled. More than 400 flights were cancelled and re-scheduled within two weeks in May alone. Further the user fee at Thiruvananthapuram Airport has been hiked by 50% by the Airport Economic Regulatory Authority, which significantly impacts air-travel and tourism sector in Kerala. In this background, I request the Hon?ble Minister for the Civil Aviation to direct the DGCA to perform its statutory duties and to cap the air fares and to penalise those air line companies who are in breach of the aircraft rules.

(Ends)

records.subject: Conjugal rights of prisoners
records.SM_Text:
Shri Haris Beeran:Conjugal rights, the right of spouses to cohabit and maintain intimate relationships, are a fundamental aspect of marriage.? This issue revolves around whether the right to conjugal visits for prisoners falls within the ambit of Article 21 of the Indian Constitution, which guarantees the right to life and personal liberty. There are an estimated number of 5,73, 220 prisoners including undertrails.

 

Prison is not just a place for punishment but also for reformation. Depriving prisoners of their conjugal rights could have negative psychological effects, increasing frustration, depression, and even leading to severe behavioral issues. Allowing conjugal visits can help maintain family ties reduce the? strain on marriages, and provide emotional support to prisoners, which can aid in their rehabilitation. Conjugal Rights can reduce instances of sexual violence within prisons, promote mental health, and aid in the maintenance? of family ties, which are crucial for post release reintegration.? Canada, Spain, Germany and in some states of US such visits are acknowledged upon the rehabilitation benefits they offer. In conclusion the conjugal rights of undertrial prisoners should be viewed not as a privilege but as a fundamental aspect of human dignity and rehabilitation.? On this crucial issue, let us remember the words of Oscar Wilde ?Every saint has a past, and every sinner has a future? Further ?Compassion will cure more than sins than condemnation?.I urge Government to look into it.

(Ends)
